summary: Tested AutoNova Phase 1 (buyer greeting, EN/FR, consent-gated referrals, requested->confirmed appointments) on backend and frontend. Backend: 18/20 pytest pass. The 2 failures are real bugs: the same slot can be requested twice (no 409), and decline returns 200 for an appointment id that does not exist. Frontend: the full customer journey works in FR. Covered: buyer greeting, lang switch (subtitle, placeholder and disclaimer in FR), Gemini replied in French (no 429), vehicle card, connect button, FR consent modal, Accept -> 'Vous êtes en contact' with referral 'sent' and lead 'sent_to_dealership' in the DB, Decline -> declined state with no referral and consent_status 'declined', and the 'Rendez-vous demandé / en attente' card with appointment status 'requested'. Dealership Appointments page: Confirm moves the card to Confirmed (lead -> appointment_confirmed); Decline moves it to Past & closed as Declined. Regression: dashboard, leads, inventory, partners, referrals and analytics all load with no page errors. Recommendations/can_refer were injected through Playwright route interception, with a real inventory_match seeded in the DB, because the AI did not reach the match stage in 1 turn.

critical.issue: Double-booking check (server.py ~L476) only looks at status in ['proposed','confirmed'], so 2 customers can both request the same slot and both get 200. Now that every new booking is 'requested', the conflict guard never fires for public bookings. Add 'requested' to the $in list.

minor.issue: Returns 200 success for a nonexistent or other-org id (no find/404 check, unlike confirm). It also does not update the lead status (the lead stays 'appointment_requested') and sends no notification to the customer.
No status precondition: a declined/cancelled/completed appointment can be re-confirmed.

Neither the consent nor the consent-agreement endpoint checks that the conversation belongs to the slug's org (cross-tenant). recipient_dealer_group_id from the client is trusted and not validated against the org's dealer groups. Accept with no inventory_match records 'accepted' but leaves lead consent_status unchanged.
Slots are stored as UTC times (e.g. 09:00+00:00) although the org time_zone is America/Toronto. Probably existing behaviour; check that the availability rules are applied in the dealer's local time.

ui_bugs.issue: recommendations, canRefer, consentResult and booked are kept only in React state. After a page reload the existing conversation is restored but the connect button, consent result and booking card disappear. The GET conversation endpoint does not return them.

fmtSlot uses toLocaleString(undefined), so slot and booking dates show in English ('Mon, Nov 23') in FR mode. Pass 'fr-CA' when lang is fr. The booking message also contains the English type 'in person appraisal' inside the French sentence.
Toast reads 'Appointment decline' / 'Appointment confirm' (it builds the text from the action verb). act() has no try/catch, so failures show nothing.
openConsent, decideConsent and book swallow errors silently (empty catch): the user gets no feedback if the call fails.

issues: Switching to FR mid-conversation leaves the earlier English greeting (acceptable, but the greeting could be re-sent).
The consent modal close (X) button has no data-testid.

action_items: Include 'requested' in the public_book conflict check so the same slot cannot be requested twice (409).
decline_appointment: return 404 when the appointment is not found, update the lead status, and optionally notify the customer.
confirm_appointment: allow it only from requested/proposed.
Public consent endpoints: check that conv.organization_id == org.id and validate recipient_dealer_group_id.
Persist and rehydrate the chat's recommendation/consent/booking state on reload (return it from GET /public/{slug}/conversations/{id}).
Localize slot dates and the appointment type in FR; fix the toast wording.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1490 lines; split it into routers (public chat, appointments, referrals, admin).
Public endpoints get conversations by id only, never scoped by slug/org.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows working (minor issues noted)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ conversations/leads/inventory_matches were created and then deleted by id: the pytest module cleanup plus a manual cleanup for the UI runs. One greeting-only EN conversation/lead (status 'new', no seller name), created by the first chat page load, was left because it could not be identified safely.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gemini worked (no 429) and replied in French. To exercise recommendations in the UI, seed an inventory_match for the lead in Mongo and intercept the POST .../messages response to add recommendations/can_refer/show_appointments. Container clock is Nov 2026. Run the test file with the default pytest.ini (xdist).
